Exactly one model.tangent_rhs per active part per stage, using that same MeanEvaluation. Physical boundary diagnostics are separate explicit readout work and do not invoke either RHS.
rk4_and_memory.atomic_reservation: Before any stage: reserve all four mean and four times active-source-part tangent calls, and check step/time cap. Insufficient reservation changes neither counters nor boundary. Failed stage preserves the prior boundary and consumed reservation/execution counters. Deadline is checked before each invocation and before publication; no preemption inside a scientific callback is claimed.
rk4_and_memory.real_codomain: For both raw classical u-dot and p-dot, every stage checks abs(imag) <= atol + rtol*abs(real), finite values, retains peak/last raw imaginary diagnostics, and refuses an excess. Only admitted ionic derivatives become real. Raw physical coefficients, electronic frames, electronic RHS and covariance tangents are not modified. Nonfinite or zero-allowance excess diagnostics remain JSON-representable.
rk4_and_memory.memory: O(sum_s npw_s*rank_s + ndof) mean and O(active_parts*(sum_s 2*npw_s*rank_s + 2*ndof)) tangent storage, with constant-factor boundary/stage/RHS/weighted-accumulation work only. No PW-square production matrices, no all-step/full-state history. Checkpoint serialization is an explicitly requested additional full boundary copy. Diagnostics emit rank-sized Gram arrays only on request. Tiny finite oracle alone retains its small comparison histories.
